description: This is a set of unit tests for encoding functionalities in the PDFsharp library, specifically testing UTF-8 encoding robustness and ANSI encoding behaviors within the context of PDF processing.

classes.name: EncodingTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests related to encoding checks in the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: Check_UTF_8_overlong_encodings
methods.description: Tests to verify that overlong UTF-8 encodings are correctly identified as invalid.

methods.name: AnsiEncodingTest
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of ANSI encoding for certain characters.

methods.name: AnsiEncoding_ANSI_to_Unicode_test_implementation
methods.description: Compares the ANSI to Unicode conversion in PDFsharp's implementation versus .NET's implementation across byte values.

methods.name: AnsiEncoding_Unicode_to_Unicode_test_implementation
methods.description: Checks the Unicode to ANSI encoding round-trip consistency in PDFsharp's implementation versus .NET.

methods.name: GetDotNetAnsiEncoding
methods.description: Retrieves the .NET implementation of code page 1252 encoding for comparison purposes.
